The two figures form a diagonal exchange of gazes across the empty center. Sophisticated old illustrated book craft, hand-painted and hand-drawn, no polished digital rendering, no generic fantasy castle, no extra characters, no slogans, no text. Entire torn sheet visible with small transparent margins. Use the reference palette and painting style exactly.
